probes.title: Disambiguation Probe: Loop Boundary vs Counting
probes.prompt: Without running code: does range(2, 5) produce 3 items or 4 items, and does it include 5?

options.text: It produces [2, 3, 4] but I counted 4 iterations because 5 - 2 = 3 + 1
It produces [2, 3, 4] which is exactly 3 items

probes.title: Disambiguation Probe: Syntax vs Logical Precedence
probes.prompt: In the statement 'if x = 10 or y == 20:', what is the primary issue preventing execution?

options.text: 'x = 10' is an assignment, which is illegal inside an if-statement
options.explanation: Correctly identifies assignment vs equality operator.

options.text: The 'or' operator evaluates before the '==' operator
A single '=' is used to compare whether x is 10

probes.title: Disambiguation Probe: Local Scope vs Shared Mutable Object
probes.prompt: Why did the outer variable retain or change its value across calls?

options.text: Assigning to a variable inside a function always overwrites the global variable
The default argument object was created once at function definition time
Default lists are recreated every time the function is called
